capabilities: Display an animated pet that roams the workspace with three rendering styles and roam modes
Run Pomodoro focus sprints and periodic wellness break reminders
Monitor pending checkbox tasks across the vault and complete them from the pet menu
Interact with the pet via a radial menu (feed, pet, play, nap, quotes)
Import custom sprites and adjust scale, speed, sounds, and settings
disambiguation: Not just a decorative pet; it also runs Pomodoro focus sessions, wellness break reminders, and lets you view and complete vault tasks.
extras: The bundled characters use names and likenesses of copyrighted movies and TV shows (Lightning McQueen, Grogu, Batman, Totoro, etc.). Installation via BRAT is documented for beta users, and the README states the plugin is fully local with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no playful desktop companion, and focus timers, break reminders, and task awareness normally require separate plugins or apps.
summary: Animated screen pet that roams the Obsidian workspace, expresses moods, and adds Pomodoro focus sprints, break reminders, and vault task notifications.
